senses.definition: n.pr. mens. Shebāṭ, 11th month (post-ex.) = Feb.–March; loan-word from Bab. Šabâṭu (COT Ne 1(×2) DlWB), Zc 1:7 (der. from šabâṭu, strike, kill, destroy (DlProl. 38; WB), Lyon Bib. Sacr. Apr. 1884, 384 JenZA iv (1889), 273 Muss-ArnJBL xi (1892), 171 f. al., as month of destroying rain; another conjecture in ZimKAT 3. 594 n.; this month called שבט also in Nab. Palm., v. Lzb SAC 111).
